title: Input-matched multi-signal colocalization clarifies immune-cell regulatory assignments at primary biliary cholangitis risk loci
description: Preprint and open research compendium for a PBC-wide screen followed by source-matched multi-signal reclassification of a prespecified high-information H3/H4 subset. The release includes the manuscript, figures, supplementary tables, machine-readable derived outputs, frozen protocols and analysis code. It distinguishes statistical signal sharing from biological mechanism and retains negative, model-sensitive and uninformative results.
